subject: reasoning
question: OM 13 is related to RP 17 in a certain way. In the same way, WU 19 is related to ZX 23. To which of the following is IG 14 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**For 'OM 13' related to 'RP 17':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae88b34e4f22f464adc034f366bb89a86d5ba85b9c50fa1b5e6fecff875f3cf8.png] 

**For 'WU 19' related to 'ZX 23':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28c8f8bce3f67ba2492d0537542c560c9bfe902d8466c875d03378414b64d8ab.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is: **First letter +3, Second letter +3, Number +4**.

**Applying the same logic to 'IG 14':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f376a7ccc9c1ab7b3d8e658b543d0806e091869831eb7d1bd9fa8d0ba57e6b5.png] 

Thus, IG 14 is related to LJ 18.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
